tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Returns the official carrier tracking URL for a DHL, FedEx, UPS or USPS tracking number (carrier auto-detected from the number format if not given). GS ships with these carriers and emails the tracking number on dispatch.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_services_and_fees · Public sink: request_assisted_purchase · Destructive: track_shipment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_services_and_fees · Public sink: request_assisted_purchase · Destructive: track_shipment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
